Plank Progression Timer

A start/stop plank hold timer with a 4-week progressive target chart built from your baseline.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Keep your back flat and stop if you feel pain.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your current best plank hold in seconds.
  2. Press Start timer, hold your plank, press Stop at failure.
  3. Your best hold is saved in this browser.
  4. Follow the 4-week target chart below the timer.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is good plank form?

Hold a straight line from head to heels, brace your core, and breathe normally. Stop if your lower back sags or hurts.

How does the timer work?

It counts your hold live and shows your best hold from this browser, plus weekly targets that grow from your baseline.

What if the targets feel too easy?

Add 10–15 seconds to your baseline and follow the same 4-week structure with 3 holds per day.
